title: Text: DET Jordan Field ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey Jordan, it’s Anthony from the Free Press. This is random but can I bug you for a Michigan Sports HOF question?
Hey Anthony.  Sure. No bother at all. Via text? Go for it.
Cool. I’m doing a little story on Mary Schroeder, our longtime photographer who is a finalist, and I’m wondering if she could be the first photographer and first female in general in the media wing
So I’m basically looking to see if you’d know anyone that might know that. This Michael Bill guy?

I don’t think Michael would be the best person to ask. He is on our Board, but is an attorney. The MSHOF elected its first class in 1954. We are believed to be the oldest state sports HOF in the country. I actually exchanged emails with Mary yesterday. I believe she is the first photographer to ever appear on the MSHOF Final Ballot (male or female). There are many women in the MSHOF. I believe the first was elected in 1965. For many years we had a “Contributor” category that included media.  In the last few years, we separated that category into two: Contributor and Media Women have been elected in the old merged “Contributor” category (ex: Mrs Ilitch). But I believe, if elected, Mary would be the first female member of the media in the MSHOF Does that help? Here is link to all hall of famers:
Oh ok! I think she mentioned that she e-mailed someone about it, I just wasn’t quite sure who
Yes, this helps. I can write my way around it, like “believed to be,” etc.
Thank you for getting back to me, I appreciate it
Yes, that was me! Happy to help. Anytime!
